name: Gedocarnil
summary: Gedocarnil (INN) is an anxiolytic of the β-carboline family related to abecarnil. It is registered as an anxiolytic under the WHO's ATC classification system; however, there are no trade names associated with it and it does not appear to have ever been marketed.
